environment.description: Flask application deployed on EC2 behind an Application Load Balancer with AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached. The WebACL includes the AWS managed rule group AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet with all rules in default action (BLOCK), applied with TextTransformation of type URL_DECODE priority 0 and HTML_ENTITY_DECODE priority 1 on query string parameters. Additionally, a custom rate-based rule limits requests to 100 per 5-minute window per source IP. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch logging is enabled for the WebACL with sampled requests retention. Note: The SQLi rule set uses libinjection-based detection which analyzes tokenized SQL fingerprints rather than simple pattern matching, covering field-injection variants including column-name position injections with UNION, subquery, and boolean-based techniques.

config.network: Public ALB with WAFv2 association, no CloudFront
